say:1:1230503001:1.text: Took a boat. See that one there?
say:1:1230503001:1.source_cn: 坐船。看到我身边那艘没？
say:1:1230503001:1.male: Took a boat. See that one there?
say:1:1230503001:1.female: Took a boat. See that one there?

say:2:1230503002:1.text: Rustport's put a blockade on deep-sea vessels, but how can anyone survive out here without fishing? Everyone's always scheming on how to slip out for a catch.
say:2:1230503002:1.source_cn: 锈锚港禁止远洋船出海，但是不捕鱼就没生计，大家都在想办...
say:2:1230503002:1.male: Rustport's put a blockade on deep-sea vessels, but how can anyone survive out here without fishing? Everyone's always scheming on how to slip out for a catch.
say:2:1230503002:1.female: Rustport's put a blockade on deep-sea vessels, but how can anyone survive out here without fishing? Everyone's always scheming on how to slip out for a catch.

say:3:1230503003:1.text: So, take a small skiff, slip into the water under cover of night, and if you're careful you won't get noticed.
say:3:1230503003:1.source_cn: 划一艘小艇，趁夜色悄悄下水，就很难被发现。
say:3:1230503003:1.male: So, take a small skiff, slip into the water under cover of night, and if you're careful you won't get noticed.
say:3:1230503003:1.female: So, take a small skiff, slip into the water under cover of night, and if you're careful you won't get noticed.

say:4:1230503004:1.text: Even if the big shots in the upper district have issued a ban, they can't keep me from the sea! Fishing has been my life for as long as I can remember!
say:4:1230503004:1.source_cn: 就算上城区的大人物下达禁令，也无法阻止我钓鱼！我的人生...
say:4:1230503004:1.male: Even if the big shots in the upper district have issued a ban, they can't keep me from the sea! Fishing has been my life for as long as I can remember!
say:4:1230503004:1.female: Even if the big shots in the upper district have issued a ban, they can't keep me from the sea! Fishing has been my life for as long as I can remember!
